L294: def _bounded_request(
L295:     request: RequestContext,
L296:     part_converter: A2APartToGenAIPartConverter,
L297: ) -> AgentRunRequest:
L298:     """Convert an A2A request with a bounded model-call budget.
L299:     ADK's converter never sets ``streaming_mode``, so A2A ``message/stream``
L300:     clients get SSE of whole events while the model runs non-streaming. With
L301:     ``AGENT_A2A_STREAMING=true``, model tokens stream as partial events too —
L302:     an explicit trade-off documented in Chapter 3.6.
L303:     """
L304:     converted = convert_a2a_request_to_agent_run_request(request, part_converter)
L305:     # --8<-- [start:verified-identity]
L306:     # A gateway-verified identity, if present, replaces the synthetic A2A id so the
L307:     # audit row (Chapter 7.6) and per-user memory key on the real caller.
L308:     verified_subject = _VERIFIED_SUBJECT.get()
L309:     if verified_subject:
L310:         converted.user_id = verified_subject
L311:     # --8<-- [end:verified-identity]
L312:     run_config = converted.run_config or RunConfig()
L313:     updates: dict[str, object] = {"max_llm_calls": settings.a2a_max_llm_calls}
L314:     if settings.a2a_streaming:
L315:         updates["streaming_mode"] = StreamingMode.SSE
L316:     converted.run_config = run_config.model_copy(update=updates)
L317:     return converted

L320:     """Create the maintained A2A executor with the bounded request policy."""

L322:         runner=runner,
L323:         config=A2aAgentExecutorConfig(
L324:             request_converter=_bounded_request,
L325:             execute_interceptors=[_error_code_interceptor()],
L326:         ),
L327:         # ADK's legacy result aggregator mutates terminal failures back to
L328:         # ``working`` before enqueueing them. The maintained executor preserves
L520:     # Build the App here rather than importing the module-level one, so an injected agent
L521:     # (tests, embedding) is governed by the same policy plugin as the shipped composition.
L522:     # ``app=`` is ADK's recommended Runner form; the deprecated ``agent=``/``plugins=`` pair
L523:     # would attach the policy to only this Runner instead of to the application.
L524:     runner = _SessionSerializingRunner(
L525:         app=build_app(selected_agent),
L526:         session_service=session_service,
L527:     )
L528:     task_engine = session_service.db_engine

L530:         runner=runner,
L531:         session_service=session_service,
L532:         task_engine=task_engine,
L533:         task_store=DatabaseTaskStore(engine=task_engine),
L534:     )
L535:     # --8<-- [end:a2a-runtime]

L537:     @asynccontextmanager
L538:     async def lifespan(_: Starlette):
L539:         try:
L540:             # The writable A2A process owns first-boot publication. Readiness
L541:             # remains a strictly read-only observation after startup. Both
L542:             # upstream stores create their schemas lazily, so initialize them
L543:             # here before readiness is allowed to report success.
L544:             recover_interrupted_restore(settings.state_dir)

L548:             await runtime.task_store.initialize()
L549:             yield
L550:         finally:
L551:             await runtime.close()

L553:     app = to_a2a(
L554:         selected_agent,
L555:         host=settings.a2a_host,
L556:         port=settings.a2a_port,
L557:         protocol=settings.a2a_protocol,
L558:         agent_card=agent_card,

L578: def main() -> None:
L579:     """Serve A2A on the configured listener while advertising its callable host.
L580:     Uvicorn owns SIGTERM: it stops accepting connections and gives in-flight
L581:     requests up to ``AGENT_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S`` to finish before forcing shutdown.
L582:     The bound reduces avoidable interruption; a turn that exceeds it can still
L583:     be cut, so state changes remain transactional rather than relying on drain
L584:     time for correctness.
L585:     """
L586:     uvicorn.run(
L587:         create_app,
L588:         factory=True,
L589:         host=settings.a2a_bind_host,
L590:         port=settings.a2a_port,
L591:         timeout_graceful_shutdown=int(settings.drain_timeout_s),
L592:     )
